text: dsh-opencode-go-usage 是 DSH Web 插件，在聊天输入框旁显示 OpenCode Go 额度图标。使用 opencode-go 或派生路由时，悬停查看 5 小时剩余额度，点击查看 5 小时、每周和每月的已用比例、剩余比例及重置时间。插件缓存查询结果并支持自动和手动刷新。需要 API key，可从 DSH credentials、环境变量或 OpenCode auth.json 读取；请求发往 opencode.ai。

dsh-opencode-go-usage shows OpenCode Go usage in the DSH web composer: five-hour remaining quota on hover; rolling, weekly, and monthly usage and reset times on click. Caches results. An API key from DSH credentials, OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY, or OpenCode auth.json authenticates requests to opencode.ai.
想在 DSH 聊天输入框旁边查看 OpenCode Go 套餐还剩多少额度。
Can I see my OpenCode Go quota and reset times while chatting in DSH?
让 DSH 显示 OpenCode Go 的每周和每月用量情况。
dsh-opencode-go-usage 的功能「查看用量窗口」：当前会话使用 OpenCode Go 路由时，点击输入框旁的图标打开面板，查看 5 小时、每周和每月窗口的已用比例、剩余比例及重置时间。
dsh-opencode-go-usage 的功能「刷新额度」：悬停或打开额度面板时自动查询，自动刷新最多每 15 秒触发一次；面板也提供手动刷新按钮，并在查询期间显示刷新状态。
dsh-opencode-go-usage 使用前须知：插件会向 opencode.ai 的用量接口发送带 Bearer key 的请求以读取额度窗口和重置时间（见 index.js:151-159）。
dsh-opencode-go-usage 使用前须知：需要 OpenCode Go API key；插件从环境变量或本机 auth.json 读取密钥并用于请求认证（见 index.js:59-87、index.js:151-159）。

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · dsh-opencode-go-usage：A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that shows your **OpenCode Go** quota next to the
context status area in the chat composer.

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · dsh-opencode-go-usage：- Hover the icon: shows the 5-hour rolling quota remaining and starts an auto refresh (throttled to once every 15 seconds)
- Click the icon: opens a panel with remaining / used percentages and reset times for 5h, weekly, and monthly windows
- The icon is visible when the current session's selected provider is an OpenCode Go route: `opencode-go` or a route key derived from it (`opencode-go-extra`, ...)
- Caches the last successful result globally: reopening the panel shows cached data and last query time immediately, then refreshes in the background
- While a query is in flight, the hover tooltip shows `refreshing…`; clicking the icon during that time does not start a duplicate request
- Auto refresh is limited to once per 15 seconds; manual refresh always queries

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Demo：After installing and restarting `dsh web`, open a session using `opencode-go`.
A small icon appears on the right side of the composer. Click it to see:

```text
OpenCode Go quota
5h    left 85%
Wk    left 71%
Mo    left 93%

dsh plugin --profile web add github:GarfieldGCat/dsh-opencode-go-usage
```

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Compatibility：| dsh | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` and later | supported |
| `0.1.x` – `0.2.0` | still loads |

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Compatibility：dsh 0.2 validates every strict Typert codec where it is registered — the
invocation result codec in `typert.host.js` and the matching descriptor in
`client.js` — and requires each to expose a `create()` factory returning the
schema. A codec carrying only a bare `schema` is refused, and because the typert
loader aggregates contributor failures, one such codec aborts the whole
activation pass and the plugin never loads:

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Compatibility：```text
typert-loader: dsh-opencode-go-usage invocation
"dsh-opencode-go-usage#opencodeUsage/usage" result codec has no create() factory
```

Earlier releases ignored the field, so the `create()` form in this release works
on both. See `typert.host.js` and the contribution in `client.js` for the exact
declaration.

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Configuration：You can override the plugin config in your web profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: opencode-go-usage
  name: dsh-opencode-go-usage
  config:
    baseUrl: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` | OpenCode Go usage endpoint |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | Request timeout in milliseconds |
| `providerIds` | `["opencode-go"]` | Route keys whose presence in Settings → Models satisfies the host precondition. Derived `opencode-go-*` routes count even when they are not listed. |
| `providerId` | — | Deprecated single-key form of `providerIds`; still accepted |

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Configuration：The browser half cannot read this config, so it matches the catalog id
`opencode-go` plus any `opencode-go-*` derived key by rule. A custom route named
anything else needs a one-line change to `isOpenCodeGoRoute` in `client.js`.

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · API key resolution：1. DSH credentials seam / environment variable `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`
2. `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json`, entry `opencode-go` (falls back to `opencode`) with `type: "api"`

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Usage endpoint：```http
GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage
Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>
```

Example response:

```json
{
  "usage": {
    "rolling": { "status": "ok", "percent": 9,  "resetsAt": "..." },
    "weekly":  { "status": "ok", "percent": 12, "resetsAt": "..." },

The endpoint returns used percentages. The plugin displays `remaining = 100 - percent`.

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Plugin structure：| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host side: provides the `opencodeUsage` Remote service, resolves the API key, and queries usage |
| `typert.host.js` | Typert host manifest |
| `client.js` | Web side: registers the icon in `conversation.input.right` and renders the popover |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that mounts the host plugin automatically |
| `package.json` | Declares `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client` |

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Visibility condition：The web client reads the current session's selected provider via `modelDirectories`:

- provider is `opencode-go`, or any route key derived from it (`opencode-go-*`, e.g. a custom `opencode-go-extra` route serving models the installed pi-ai catalog has not shipped yet) → show the icon
- any other provider → hide the icon

The host half applies the same rule when it checks Settings → Models, so a
derived route reports real quota instead of `not-in-models`.

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Visibility condition：The host reads that catalog through the settings service's current surface
(`describe()` on dsh >= 0.2, the older `get(ns)` before it). A settings surface
the plugin cannot read at all leaves the verdict undetermined and it proceeds to
the request rather than reporting `not-in-models`: the icon is already gated on
the session's live provider, so refusing there would only replace a real request
with a misleading message.

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Visibility condition：Since v0.2.0 the client declares `modelDirectories` in its `inject` list, so
activation waits for the model-selection service before registering the icon.
Without that declaration, dsh >= 0.1.3 (which activates client rows as their
injected services resolve) could run `apply` before the service exists and
silently never show the icon.

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · Known limitations：- The usage endpoint is undocumented and may change in the future.
- The endpoint only returns percentages, not dollar amounts; the plugin shows percentages and reset times.
- The cache is global: the same OpenCode Go account shares the same quota across sessions.

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · dsh-opencode-go-usage：一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：在聊天输入框的上下文状态区域旁边显示

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · 兼容性：| dsh 版本 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` 及以后 | 支持 |
| `0.1.x` – `0.2.0` | 仍可加载 |

dsh 0.2 会在注册处校验每一个 strict 类型的 Typert 编解码器——`typert.host.js`
里的调用结果编解码器，以及 `client.js` 里对应的描述符——要求它们提供返回
schema 的 `create()` 工厂。只带一个裸 `schema` 的编解码器会被拒绝；而 typert
loader 会把各贡献者的失败聚合上报，所以一个不合规的编解码器会直接中断整个激活
流程，插件完全无法加载：

```text
typert-loader: dsh-opencode-go-usage invocation
"dsh-opencode-go-usage#opencodeUsage/usage" result codec has no create() factory
```

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · 兼容性：旧版本忽略这个字段，因此本版本采用的 `create()` 写法在两端都能用。具体声明见
`typert.host.js` 和 `client.js` 中的贡献定义。

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · 配置：插件行可以通过 web profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖配置：

```yaml
- id: opencode-go-usage
  name: dsh-opencode-go-usage
  config:
    baseUrl: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` | OpenCode Go 用量接口 |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | 查询超时时间（毫秒） |
| `providerIds` | `["opencode-go"]` | 出现在「设置 → 模型」里即满足 host 前置检查的路由键；派生的 `opencode-go-*` 路由即使不列在这里也会被识别 |
| `providerId` | — | 已废弃的单值写法，仍兼容 |

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · 配置：浏览器端读不到这份 config，因此它按规则匹配目录 id `opencode-go` 以及任何
`opencode-go-*` 派生路由键。若自定义路由取了别的名字，需要在 `client.js` 的
`isOpenCodeGoRoute` 里补一行。

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · API Key 解析顺序：1. DSH credentials seam / 环境变量 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`
2. `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` 中的 `opencode-go` 条目
   （找不到时回退到 `opencode`），且 `type` 为 `api`

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · 用量接口：```http
GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage
Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>
```

返回示例：

```json
{
  "usage": {
    "rolling": { "status": "ok", "percent": 9,  "resetsAt": "..." },
    "weekly":  { "status": "ok", "percent": 12, "resetsAt": "..." },

接口返回的是已用百分比，插件显示 `剩余 = 100 - percent`。

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · 插件结构：| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host 端：提供 `opencodeUsage` Remote 服务，读取 API Key 并查询用量 |
| `typert.host.js` | Typert Host manifest |
| `client.js` | Web 端：在 `conversation.input.right` 注册图标和弹出面板 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch，自动挂载 Host 插件行 |
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client` 双端声明 |

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · 显示条件：Web 端通过 `modelDirectories` 读取当前会话实际选择的 provider：

- provider 是 `opencode-go`，或由它派生的路由键（`opencode-go-*`，例如承载
  目录尚未收录模型的自定义路由 `opencode-go-extra`）：显示图标
- 其他 provider：不显示图标

host 端检查「设置 → 模型」时用的是同一条规则，因此派生路由会返回真实额度，
而不是 `not-in-models`。

host 端按设置服务当前的可读接口读取该目录（dsh >= 0.2 是 `describe()`，更早是
`get(ns)`）。如果这个接口完全读不到，结论记为「未定」，插件直接继续发起请求，
而不是报 `not-in-models`：图标本身已经由会话当前 provider 把关，此时拒绝只会
用一个误导性提示替换掉一次真实请求。

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · 显示条件：自 v0.2.0 起，客户端在 `inject` 中显式声明 `modelDirectories` 依赖，激活会等待
模型选择服务就绪后再注册图标。若不声明，dsh >= 0.1.3（客户端按注入服务逐个
激活插件）可能在该服务建立前执行 `apply` 并静默返回，导致图标不再出现。

dsh-opencode-go-usage README · 已知限制：- 用量接口尚未写入 OpenCode 公开文档，未来可能变更。
- 接口只返回使用百分比，不返回金额；插件展示百分比和重置时间。
- 缓存是全局缓存：同一个 OpenCode Go 账号在不同会话中的额度查询结果一致。
